status: PROTOTYPE. Real media only, from her own public posts and YouTube uploads (platform exports, not originals). Client consent for names and guest-inclusive media given (PHASE-24); photographer/videographer licences unconfirmed. Nothing here is approved by Nisha.
rules: Stills: AVIF + JPEG at source widths only (480/960/1440/2400 ladder, capped at the source width, never upscaled). Use max-width = w.
Clips: H.264 High, <=720 px, faststart, audio removed unless sound:true. Sound clips are loudness-normalised to -16 LUFS; none has been auditioned by a person.
Captions are HTML or <track>, never burned in. Only voice-datamatics cues 1-4 and the showreel cues 1-4 carry text.
client:null means the client must not be named. Datamatics (r111): never print a year.
Show the clearance list as the CLEARANCE PENDING mark wherever it is non-empty and mentions "pending".

Never use: SBI Life media, Prototype-22 nisha-45.vtt, the Shapoorji 0:23 laugh as a reaction to her, the Meta-AI-watermarked SC WIN still, hcmc stills as a client credit, YouTube end cards, the 12 wrong-person Facebook files, the personal folder.
